chat.author: Chris Lemmons
chat.text:
Responding to comments...

Turing complete COSE, here we come!

Not in my draft. If you want loops you gotta bring your own draft. :)

NOR ... NOT

NOR means precisely "not or". In a very early draft, we had "not" instead, but most uses did "not: {or: [...]}". We simplified to a single NOR because it basically serves both purposes. You can just do nor with a single claimset.

geopriv

We looked at that one. Someone else can define a more flexible claim if they really want. The CAT draft recommends geohash because it has some of the best privacy properties (as long as the subject is not in motion). It's always a compromise, though. But geocoord and geoiso3166 are defined as well, because the standards process is hard. :)
